Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_ExpirationMin: Minimum Days Until Water Goes Bad
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_ExpirationMin_toolt: In days, the earliest the water can go bad. This only starts counting after the water shutoff.
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_ExpirationMax: Maximum Days Until Water Goes Bad
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_ExpirationMax_toolt: In days, the latest the water can go bad. This only starts counting after the water shutoff.
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_NeedFilterWater_too: Players must add filters to their plumbed sinks to clean the water. Otherwise, plumbed sinks are always safe water, even if their water source isn't (like vanilla).
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_WaterReductionRate_: How much water will be removed from each tap per day as a fraction of their total capacity. For example, if this value is 0.2, a tap will lose 20%% of its maximum water each day. Individual taps will have slight random variance from this value. <LINE> If set to 1, all taps will reach their minimum value immediately when the water shuts off. <LINE> If set to 0, water will not drain.
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_MinimumWaterLeft_to: Amount of water that will not be drained from taps by as a fraction of their total capacity. For example, if this value is 0.2, a tap will not drain past 20%% of its total capacity.
Sandbox_WaterGoesBad_TapSizeScalar_toolt: Multiplier to the water capacity of taps. Does not affect other liquid containers. <LINE> Changing this mid-save does not change the capacity of already loaded taps.
